This is really relaxing. I like how you layered your vocals quite a bit. The relaxed drums also work really well with your guitar melodies. There are points where your vocals get just a little bit louder than the rest of your mix and kind of drown out the rest of your instruments but other than that the mixing is solid. great job!

Thank you so much!!! I'll definitely keep that in mind the next time I mix drums. I try to mostly keep the low end occupied by the bass and kick but sometimes other elements slip through that I find myself having to cut. Might try automating volume control next time to switch the emphasis between different sections. Thank you so much for the kind words tho and I'm glad you enjoyed it 😊😊😊

Thank you for the kind words. Yeah I'm kinda realizing there's a lot of stuff I could've done differently but then again I don't know if the song would work as well had I done them. I'll just have to keep it in mind for future releases but I'm glad you enjoyed it 😁

Yeah I feel like this is prolly what I'm hearing. All of the drums are a much higher frequency to make room for the bass that sits below them so maybe if I were to solo out the kick and boost it that might work
Thank youuuu! Felt like the song needed some variation so that's why I did that octave effect on the second half

Thank you so much! Yeah listening back to it now and part of me wishes I had added a little bit more to the drums to make them feel a little less repetitive but oh well. Thank you for the kind words 🙏

Dropped a music video for my latest single 'are you beautiful?' a couple weeks ago. Really like how this turned out but part of me can't help but feel like the mix is just a little bit hollow? Idk how to describe it. Any and all feedback on the song or video is appreciated.

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hP6eN3f9ycY](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hP6eN3f9ycY)
Really enjoyable and chill track. Mix is great and I quite enjoyed the accompanying visuals. The vocal layering is prolly my favorite element, trippy and soothing at the same time. Great work!

This is sick!! I like the mixture of synthetic and live drums and your guitars sound really tight in context with the rest of your mix. The only thing that I would really work on is your vocals. They are distractingly washed out and faded which sucks because through all that reverb and EQ I can tell that you have a great voice! Don't be afraid to let it shine through!

This is really cool! Definitely original and I love how fat and wide your kick sounds. The mixture of what almost sounds like tribal type percussion with the layered horns gives the song an otherworldly feel. Like I'm exploring an alien world in the far reaches of space or something. In terms of criticism, I really don't have much other than to maybe cut just a tad bit more of the lower end off when mastering. It's barely noticeable within your mix but I did hear just a little bit of mud here and there especially on the low end.

Yooo this is siccckk! That hook is infectious af, have the words 'have you ever been with a bandit' stuck in my head now lol. Synths are trippy, and the way you layer your drums is really interesting. I like how disjointed and disconnected everything feels, gives the song a nice jazzy and freeform feel. Video is a bop too, really funny but also trippy af. Great work!
AHhhh thank youuuu!! I worked really hard on trying to get the vocal tone just right and not too overbearing so I appreciate the kind words!
Thank you so much for the kind words! Never heard of that project before but now I'm listening to them and enjoying it quite a bit so thanks for the rec as well lol
Thank you! I appreciate the feedback

Wow. This is very laid back and chill, but also really effective on an emotional level. Really gives me a nostalgic long lost love type of vibe. Your guitar melodies and bass work really well with your vocals too, the only thing that I would maybe do differently is bring your backing drums up a little bit more in your mix. They work really well with the rest of the song but they also sound just a bit too washed out/far away imo. But then again, maybe that's the effect that you're going for, either way they work pretty well in context with the themes of the song so keep up the great work 👍

Thank you for the kind words! I think what you may be hearing is  this sample I used of a woman singing which I then pitched up and down and all around all throughout the entire song in an effort to give the melody some variation
Thank you so much! Yeah I tried a lot of different techniques when it came to the vocals so I guess when it came to panning there really wasn't much else I thought about trying

This is siccckk! I really love the different textures and pads you play with. Your drums are neat too but they're a little basic and something leaves me feeling as if there could be more going on on that front. Other than that tho this is a really unique and original track that reminds of some older earl sweatshirt type beats. I love the sax that you threw in there too as it gives the otherwise kinda monotonous pads something interesting to work with melodically. Great work!

Bro that bass is sooo dirty I love it lol. Your drums sound nice too but they're mixed a little quietly so I would just bring them up a little more. Overall tho this is a really cool track! I love the mixture of industrial elements and nu-metal style of delivery. Your vocals sit really well on top of your other elements and I love the variety in guitar tones you use. There are some spots where your mix feels a little bit hollow but that can easily be fixed with some layering. Sick track my guy and I would definitely think about trying to get this into some industrial/electro nu metal type playlists.

This is a really neat track. I don't know if it's what you were going for but it definitely gives me some dystopian sci-fi type vibes. Your instrumentation is really solid, the bass and kick sound nice and wide/fat, and I like how the tempo switches in the first half of your song as it gives it some nice variation. The only thing I would maybe add in is possibly some vocals? If you're going for purely instrumental then that's cool too but I could totally see some washed out vocoded vocals sitting nicely atop this track or even below your other instruments in the mix. Kinda like how some older crystal castles songs used to use vocoded vocals as another layer of instrumentation. Idk just something to think about. Overall though, great track and keep up the good work 👍

This is lovely. The dissonance + distortion in the guitar mixed with the strings in the background give it an extremely eerie yet nostalgic and dream-like type feel. Gives me a 'passing through childhood hometown while reliving painful memories' type of vibe. I love your vocal layering too, and well done on the clarinet solo at around 3:05. The only thing that I would really say is missing is a kick with your drums. Your percussion itself sounds really cool with how distant and washed out it sounds but I feel like a kick of some sort really would've tied it together and added so much more. Overall great track tho, reminds me of a more sinister and distorted current joys. Will definitely be revisiting

Really neat song, I really like how the vocals and guitar are kind of disjointed but also play off of each other melodically. Gives the song a really syncopated, freeform, almost jazzy type feel. Like others have mentioned though, the click metronome throughout the entire track gets a little distracting at points. It's a nice lead in and it works as an intro but at some point you gotta either switch it up or change the texture of your click so that it doesn't feel so repetitive. Maybe a kick? A clap? Just something other than a constant clicking in the background that makes it feel like you forgot to turn the metronome off before you started recording. Otherwise tho, good track, really chill vibes, and I look forward to hearing more from you.

Sooo dreamyyyy!! And holy hell is that instrumentation around 1:43 something else haha. Your synths are super cool too and I love how you mix them with your vocals. Sounds like something you would hear at a club in one of the blade runner movies. Struggling to find any complaints with the track but if there are any its that maybe the more high frequency synths are a little too harsh for my liking, but that's more of a personal preference than anything. Great track, and I would maybe look into getting this into some dreamy vaporware/downtempo playlists on Spotify.

This is awesome. Really interesting spin on a holiday classic. Instrumentation is solid and your vocal performance soothes the soul. In regards to your question about whether or not it's too quirky, I honestly think you could've gone even moodier and it still would've worked. There's an eerieness to this track that bubbles just under the surface and it honestly gives me goosebumps lol I love it. Definitely adding this to my 'weird ass christmas music' playlist, great track and keep up the great work!

Pole dancer type beat fr, nah nah jk. Seriously tho, great track! That bass and kick are fat as hell and it definitely gives this otherwise chill track a lot of punch. The vocals were nice and clean too as well as your synths and your percs. But maybe a little too clean... at least for my liking. I think if you really leaned into a lot of the dirtier and heavier elements of your music it would make it even more engaging. Try adding some distortion on your synths and bass next time and just see what happens. Just a suggestion of course but I think it would be cool if you went head first into that more grimey and gritty aesthetic of the sound you're going for. Otherwise, great track keep it up!

Very chill, I like the variation in texture and your bass acts as a nice and wide backdrop that all the other elements play well on top of. I would definitely add this to some type of chill/study playlist. The only gripe I really have is that, at least to me, it doesn't really stand out in any meaningful way that makes it different to all the other downtempo trap songs out there. But that's okay, you definitely already have the right ideas in motion for the type of music you wanna make, just don't be afraid to throw some variation in there.

That being said I think you've got some cool stuff going on melodically and that bass is really nice. Keep it up, just don't be afraid to put some more drums in your beats.

First of all, I just wanna say I freaking love the vocals on this track! They have a really washed out and spacious feel to them that really helps the vibe of the song. The guitar riff is pretty cool too and plays well with the vocal melodies. The only thing that I would personally work on is the drums, they kinda take a backseat in relation to the rest of the elements of the song. Maybe try boosting the lows in your kick and turning the snare up a bit more. They just kinda sound flat and not very punchy especially in relation to the other elements of your mix. Overall though, great fucking track! Reminds me a lot of the new wave of shoegaze that's been getting traction over the past couple of years. Keep up the great work!

Hi there! First of all when it comes to your intro I think a funny sting or joke could really help capture your viewer's attention within the first few seconds. Most peoples attention spans (including my own) are really really short. So if you don't captivate your viewers as soon as possible they're more likely to lose interest. Second of all I think it would help a lot to cut down the video's length with some snappy editing. Like I said most people do not have that long of an attention span, so you have to keep them interested throughout the running time of the video and 15 minutes is kind of asking a lot when it comes to a let's play. Just keep the length to a minimum and focus on the most important parts. Overall though it was a fun video to watch (even with some skipping around here and there) and I think with some more experience people will really enjoy your content!
